items.html:
Nicholas Ifill is an all-rounder who bowls a tidy medium pace,
and bats in the middle order. He played in the 1988-9 under-19
World Cup in Australia for the  ICC Affiliate team and was a
stand-by for the Canadian squad for the 1997 ICC Trophy. Perhaps
his best performance for the national team was against Bermuda in
the 2000 Americas Cup, taking 3 wickets, and making 78 to earn
the man-of-the-match award as Canada clinched the cup. He played
for Canada in the 2000 Red Stripe bowl recording some useful
bowling performances, notably bowling 7 overs for only 11 runs
against Trinidad and Tobago and taking 3/22 against the USA
(including the hat-trick).  He plays for Victoria Park CC in the
Toronto and District League (Dave Liverman 2002).
